description: Registry of declared, bounded divergences between the Git-tracked body of an ALREADY-APPLIED production migration and the checksum recorded in production's _prisma_migrations journal. The historical migration is never edited, renamed or moved; each divergence is closed forward-only. The governance guard (scripts/db/verify-migration-checksum-exceptions.mjs) must FAIL CLOSED on any divergence not declared here, on any checksum mismatch (one-byte mutation), on a missing file, or on a non-canonical final schema.

exceptions.repoBodyProvenance: Git HEAD tree — guarded no-op variant (DO $$ IF to_regclass('public.maths_progress') IS NOT NULL ...), required so a from-empty rebuild stays green because public.maths_progress is only created later by 20260501000000_add_maths_progress.
exceptions.productionBodyProvenance: Unguarded 418-byte body actually executed in production on 2026-04-25 (git object ddf0d7111), preserved verbatim out of the active migrations tree.
exceptions.cause: Historical inversion of the table-creation order: production applied the ADD COLUMN while public.maths_progress already existed, whereas the Git order only creates the table later; a guarded variant was introduced in-tree afterwards to keep from-empty rebuilds green, producing a checksum drift against the body actually applied.

phaseFingerprints.description: Fingerprints are bound to the migration phase; none is accepted outside its phase. PRE_PENDING: production lineage recognized, the single historical divergence present, the forward reconciliation NOT yet applied. POST_APPLIED: the reconciliation was applied by this deploy (from the PRE_PENDING state, or on a from-empty rebuild). ALREADY_RECONCILED: the reconciliation was already applied before this deploy. Catalogs are produced read-only by catalogQuery; journals are the sorted name|checksum lines of applied (finished, not rolled back) migrations.

POST.journal: Applied migration names must equal the repository migration set exactly; checksums must equal the repository bodies except the declared historical tuple.
